name: tt-tnt-1024
description: TT-TNT-1024 -- a Llama-3-style model sized for Tenstorrent: num_groups=4 so it shards across 1, 2 or 4 chips, and a derived SwiGLU width of 2816 (88 tiles = 8x11) that fits a harvested Blackhole grid at 80%. Weights are the 'dialogue' run at 512 context: 123M parameters, 10,764 steps on a corpus carrying a 2% instruction slice. It answers questions in form and sometimes in fact. Ships a chat template capping rendered conversation history at 5 messages -- that guard, not a larger context, is what prevents the growing-conversation KV-cache crash (a generic tt-metal/vLLM defect, docs/upstream-tt-metal-asks.md entry 6): verified at 512 context, 14 growing turns, zero crashes. A 2048-context variant was trained, published, and REVERTED on 2026-08-29 because it answered measurably worse; see train/configs/model/tt-tnt-1024.yaml.
